Question: Explain how the poet uses imagery and symbolism to develop the central theme of a prescribed poem.
reference_answer: The poet selects sensory images and recurring symbols that embody the theme. For example, images of light and darkness may symbolise hope and despair; the pattern of images builds meaning beyond the literal level.
